text: This report provides an update on the actions taken by Corporate Finance staff with regard to the selection of investment managers since the last meeting of the Toronto Investment Board (the "Board") on April 11, 2019. An update to the Investment Plan is provided given the contract negotiations with the Fixed Income investment managers is now complete. The confidential attachments outline details regarding the negotiations with the Global Equity investment managers and recommends a course of action.

The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Approved the updated Investment Plan as outlined in Attachment 1 to the report (May 30, 2019) from the Executive Director, Corporate Finance. 2. In respect of the global equity mandates, authorized the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, in consultation with the City Solicitor, to discontinue agreement negotiations with the firm recommended in Confidential Attachment 2 to the report (May 30, 2019) from the Executive Director, Corporate Finance, should the terms be unsatisfactory to the City Solicitor and the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, and to start negotiations with the firm identified as the second recommended firm in Confidential Attachment 2 to the report (May 30, 2019) from the Executive Director, Corporate Finance as a replacement for the original firm selected, and should negotiations with that second firm be unsuccessful, the portion…
